title: GATE Program UK equivalent
content: Hi dreamers, Just seeking some insight if anyone has any. I’m from the UK originally, born in 1992, and whilst I can’t find anything online about a GATE program equivalent in the UK, I do recall being taken out of class to do one on one / small group learning outside of the normal curriculum whilst in years 1-6 (5-12 years old). I was ranked highly in my maths and English, so I’m just wondering if anyone knows if there was an equivalent program in Britain / Europe? I’ve dreamt in MW for as long as I can remember, even having nightmares age 5 and 6 that would wake me up with nose bleeds frequently.
